claims.content: To view the sales history and summary details of a particular distributor.

goal.raw_text: To view the sales history and summary details of a particular distributor.

claims.content: The VMU User selects a particular distributor to view their sales details.

trigger.raw_text: The VMU User selects a particular distributor to view their sales details.

claims.content: The VMU User navigates to the distributor master screen.
The system displays the list of distributors with their summary details.
The VMU User selects a particular distributor by double-clicking on the grid entry for that distributor.

The system retrieves and displays the detailed sales history for the selected distributor, including Batch No, Date of purchase, Qty Purchase, Qty Sold, Qty Returned, Balance Qty, and any other required details.
The VMU User reviews the displayed sales history information.
The system checks if the user has the necessary User Login Permission to print the report; if not, the print option is unavailable and the use case exits.
